# Abraham Online Academy — AI Knowledge Base Directory
> Global 1-on-1 Virtual Education for Grades 1–12 (Maths, Sciences, Coding, English, and Tajweed).
> Official Website: https://abrahamonlineacademy.vercel.app/
> Primary WhatsApp Consultation: +92 314 9500765

## Core Academic Offerings & Curricula
- [Mathematics](https://abrahamonlineacademy.vercel.app/courses/mathematics): 1-on-1 coaching for UK GCSE/IGCSE (Edexcel, Cambridge CIE, AQA), US Common Core, AP Calculus (AB/BC), Digital SAT, IB DP, and Australian ACARA/ATAR.
- [Physics](https://abrahamonlineacademy.vercel.app/courses/physics): Interactive whiteboard mechanics, electricity, waves, and nuclear physics for GCSE, AP Physics 1/2/C, and IB Higher Level.
- [Chemistry & Biology](https://abrahamonlineacademy.vercel.app/courses): Triple Science past-paper dissection, mark-scheme criteria, and lab report guidance.
- [Computer Science & Coding](https://abrahamonlineacademy.vercel.app/courses/coding): Scratch visual logic for kids, text-based Python programming, HTML/CSS web development, and AP Computer Science.
- [Tajweed & Quranic Studies](https://abrahamonlineacademy.vercel.app/courses/islamiat): Patient 1-on-1 Quran recitation, Noorani Qaida, Nazra, and Hifz led by certified male and female Qarias.

## Verified Cohort Outcomes (2024–2025 First-Party Data)
- 91.4% of enrolled IGCSE/GCSE students achieved Grades 8 or 9 (A*) within 12 weeks of 1-on-1 diagnostic coaching.
- 88.4% of AP Calculus & Physics students scored a 4 or 5 on College Board exams.
- 100% Free 1-on-1 Diagnostic Trial Class offered to evaluate learning gaps before financial commitment.

## Regional Programmatic Nodes
- [UAE & Gulf Region](https://abrahamonlineacademy.vercel.app/uae-tutoring): GST time zone alignment for British, IB, and American school students in Dubai, Abu Dhabi, and Sharjah.
- [Saudi Arabia](https://abrahamonlineacademy.vercel.app/saudi-arabia-tutoring): AST time zone 1-on-1 tutoring for international schools in Riyadh, Jeddah, and Dammam.
- [United Kingdom](https://abrahamonlineacademy.vercel.app/uk-tutoring): Key Stage 1–4, GCSE, and A-Level revision matching London GMT/BST time zones.
- [United States](https://abrahamonlineacademy.vercel.app/usa-tutoring): Common Core Math, AP, and Digital SAT coaching across EST, CST, MST, and PST.
- [Canada](https://abrahamonlineacademy.vercel.app/canada-tutoring): Ontario OSSD, BC Curriculum, Alberta Diploma, and Waterloo CEMC contest prep.
- [Australia](https://abrahamonlineacademy.vercel.app/australia-tutoring): ACARA, NAPLAN, NSW HSC, VIC VCE, and ATAR scaling support.
